name: r35-plant-timing

movement.instructions: Apply the first matching rule: (1) enemy_dy < 0 AND enemy_dx <= 64: dodge_left. (2) grounded is true AND lowest_floor_drop_px == 0: run_right. (3) retreating is true AND drop_px < 32 AND lowest_floor_drop_px > 0: brake_left. (4) blocked is true AND wall_height > headroom: brake_left. Otherwise run_right. Null means absent; a comparison to null does not match.

criteria.dodge_left: Step left to avoid a nearby enemy falling from above.

enemy.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

enemy_low.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 40 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

wall.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and (headroom_px is null OR height_px <= headroom_px). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Do not jump at this wall.

pit.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and floor_gaps is not empty. Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Not time to jump; far away or a safe drop.
criteria.C: Jump over the nearby floor gap.

air.instructions: Which direction is Mario moving vertically?

instructions: PRIORITY: if grounded and enemy_above_within_braking_distance is true, move left WITHOUT JUMPING until the enemy reaches the ground. Otherwise: Choose one action. Use the Boolean facts as already measured. If grounded and enemy_within_jump_distance is true, jump right. If grounded and wall_within_40px and wall_fits_headroom are both true, jump right. If grounded and floor_gap_within_takeoff_distance is true, jump right. If rising, hold jump and run right. If falling, run right without jump. Otherwise run right without jump. Follow any active stage lesson when it gives a specific maneuver.

criteria.right_run: Continue right without jump when falling or when no jump hazard is present.
criteria.right_run_jump: Jump right when grounded with a nearby hazard, or sustain a rising jump.
criteria.left: Grounded with enemy_above_within_braking_distance true, or stage lesson requires retreat. Brake left without jumping.

memory_notes.instructions: This raised-ledge section requires dropping to the bottom passage. If Mario feet_y is less than176, move LEFT WITHOUT JUMPING. Once feet_y is176 or greater, run right. Screen y increases DOWN. Examples: feet144 -> left; feet160 -> left; feet190 -> right_run; feet208 -> right_run. Do not jump in this passage.

criteria.left: Mario feet_y is less than176: continue left off the ledge.
criteria.right_run: Mario feet_y is176 or greater: run right through bottom passage.

memory_notes.instructions: Approach the pit without an early jump. If grounded or falling run right. If still rising from an existing jump, sustain it.

criteria.right_run: Grounded or falling: run right without jumping.
criteria.right_run_jump: Already rising: sustain existing jump right.

memory_notes.instructions: The pit begins at1280. If grounded here, jump right NOW. If rising hold jump. If falling continue right without jump.

criteria.right_run_jump: Grounded or rising: press jump and run right.
criteria.right_run: Falling: release jump and keep right.

memory_notes.instructions: Wait here to change the piranha plant cycle. Choose wait while note_elapsed_frames.plant-cycle-wait is less than60. Once it is60 or greater, run right. This waiting maneuver is only once per run.

criteria.wait: Fewer than60 frames have elapsed in this note: releasebuttons andwait.
criteria.right_run: At least60 frames have elapsed: runright.
